_comment: The County of San Diego's Beach & Bay Water Quality Monitoring Program (DEHQ) stations at Coronado's three breaks, as the owner named them (2026-10-30). IDs only, never a coordinate: `site` is the county site's own record id (its SamplesReport?SiteId=), `station` its station code. Read by collector.beachwater; the county may renumber, and a station the site no longer lists is reported, never guessed.
